operators.name: prelu_forward
semantics: Computes PReLU elementwise: output = x if x > 0 else weight[c] * x, where c is the channel index derived from the tensor's second dimension (assuming NCHW layout).
The input x is expected to be a 4D tensor of shape [N, C, H, W]; weight has length C and is broadcast along the channel dimension.
Broadcasting follows PyTorch PReLU rules for num_parameters=1 or num_parameters=C; here num_parameters equals num_channels, so per-channel weights are used.
The operator launches a CUDA kernel and returns a new tensor with the same shape, dtype, and device as x.
Applies PReLU activation elementwise on x using the learned weight parameter prelu.weight.
The implementation must match the behavior of torch.nn.PReLU with num_parameters equal to the number of channels (3) for input shape [512, 3, 512, 512].
Output dtype and shape are identical to reference: float32, [512, 3, 512, 512], CUDA device.
